acceptance_criteria: RustCryptoVerifier contains no todo!(); cargo check --package pkix-chain-simple passes; clippy -D warnings passes.
description:
**What:** Replace the todo!() in pkix-chain-simple's internal RustCryptoVerifier::verify_signature with a delegation to pkix_path::DefaultVerifier, eliminating the duplicate implementation.

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-8wg (DefaultVerifier must exist), PKIX-q13 (verify_signature return type must be Result<(), signature::Error> before this compiles correctly).

**Algorithm:**
1. In pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs, change RustCryptoVerifier from a zero-sized stub to a newtype wrapper:
   struct RustCryptoVerifier(pkix_path::DefaultVerifier);
2. Implement Default for RustCryptoVerifier:
   impl Default for RustCryptoVerifier {
       fn default() -> Self { Self(pkix_path::DefaultVerifier) }
   }
3. Implement SignatureVerifier for RustCryptoVerifier by delegating:
   fn verify_signature(&self, algorithm, issuer_spki, message, signature) -> Result<(), signature::Error> {
       self.0.verify_signature(algorithm, issuer_spki, message, signature)
   }
4. In verify_simple(), update construction: &RustCryptoVerifier::default() or &RustCryptoVerifier(pkix_path::DefaultVerifier).
5. Remove the todo!() entirely.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- This bead contains zero new logic — it is purely delegation. If any error path requires new logic, something is wrong with the approach; stop and surface to human.
- No unwrap() anywhere.

**Subagent instructions:**
Single subagent. Read both pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs and pkix-path/src/lib.rs (post-PKIX-8wg) before writing. Confirm DefaultVerifier's exact type signature. Then implement. This bead should take under 30 minutes.

**Tests:**
- test_rust_crypto_verifier_delegates: (compile-time only until PKIX-h6z) confirm RustCryptoVerifier::verify_signature compiles and calls DefaultVerifier. Oracle: compiler.
- Note: runtime tests belong in PKIX-mee (integration tests for verify_simple).
title: pkix-chain-simple: wire RustCryptoVerifier to DefaultVerifier
